description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Peace and Stabilisation Programme (PSP) Horn of Africa (HoA) IV Programme is:
To contribute to addressing the root causes of insecurity and instability in the Horn of Africa, and help mitigate the consequences in Somalia, Ethiopia and Kenya and their destabilising impact on each other in an effort to improve personal security, peace and stability in the region.
This engagement is contributing to both pillars of the PSP HOA IV programme namely both outcome 1 and 2.
Outcome 1: Political Stability - Political settlements in Somalia at federal, state and local level, in the Somali region of Ethiopia and targeted regional cross border areas are more inclusive and stable.
Outcome 2: Preventing & countering violent extremism (VE) and transnational organized crime (SOC) – Violent Extremist Organisation’s (VEOs) and SOC networks’ influence and their means of gaining revenue and capabilities in the Horn of Africa on land and at sea are diminished through strengthened bilateral and regional capabilities.
The engagement is cross cutting in the PSP HoA TOC contributing to both Outcome 1 and Outcome 2 in that the reintegration pillar is closely linked to the efforts made by stability and stabilisation actors to enhance political stability and settlements (Outcome 1); as well as a more direct focus on how to counter AS through defections (Outcome 2).
